1: -module(growth_SUITE).
    2: -moduledoc """
    3: Slice D acceptance: **committee growth 1→4 over loopback QUIC with ZERO resolver pre-seeding**.
    4: 
    5: A founder (`mode=create`, N=1) and up to four `mode=join` joiners, each in its own OS Erlang node with
    6: its own QUIC listener + Ed25519 identity. Unlike `simplex_SUITE` (which pre-seeds every peer's pubkey→addr
    7: before co-founding), NOTHING here calls `quod_quic:learn` — every dial hint must establish itself: a
    8: joiner reaches the founder by its seed ENDPOINT (catch-up); the founder learns the joiner from its inbound
    9: request header; and — the seam this slice exists for — a member reaches a **brand-new member it never met**
   10: because the new member's `peer_admitted` address is folded out of the committed log
   11: (`quod_simplex:learn_member_endpoints` at catch-up, `quod_quic:learn` at the live commit). The N=3 probe is
   12: the load-bearing proof: `quorum(3)=3` cannot commit unless J1 and J2 — who only ever learned each other
   13: through the log — actually dial each other.
   14: 
   15: Keys are chained (`quod_ct:generate_key_gt`) so pubkey sort order = admission order, making round-robin
   16: leadership computable at every N. The genesis is a test-local **default-open** `can_join` `.pl`; case 1
   17: performs the production-rollout policy upgrade (`can_join :- peer_ready`) as one atomic tx, so every later
   18: admit runs the real Slice-C readiness gate. Ordered; state threads via `save_config`.
   19: """.
   20: -include_lib("common_test/include/ct.hrl").
   21: -include_lib("stdlib/include/assert.hrl").
   22: -include("quod_ledger.hrl").
   23: -import(quod_ct, [eventually/2, match_ok/1, ordinary_write_ok/1]).
   24: 
   25: -export([all/0, init_per_suite/1, end_per_suite/1]).
   26: -export([policy_upgrade_live/1, admit_refused_mid_catchup/1,
   27:          grow_to_two/1, grow_to_three/1, grow_to_four/1,
   28:          rotation_sweep/1, byzantine_on_grown_committee/1,
   29:          dead_member_removed/1, demote_to_observer/1]).
   30: -export([pump/2]).   %% run ON the founder peer to build a multi-window log without per-write CT round-trips
   31: 
   32: -define(NS, <<"grow:d">>).
   33: -define(FOUNDER_PORT, 15860).
   34: -define(JOINER_PORTS, #{1 => 15861, 2 => 15862, 3 => 15863, 4 => 15864}).
   35: -define(DELTA_MS, 4000).      %% Δ_timeout — above the cold first commit round, below the eventually budgets
   36: -define(PUMP, 300).           %% > ?WINDOW (256): a multi-window log so catch-up spans >1 window (learn hook)
   37: -define(SLOW_DIGEST, 7500).   %% J1's pinned digest period — the max readiness_config_ok/1 admits; its
   38:                               %% ~6s jitter floor makes the mid-catchup admit refusal independent of catch-up speed
   39: 
   40: all() -> [policy_upgrade_live, admit_refused_mid_catchup,
   41:           grow_to_two, grow_to_three, grow_to_four,
   42:           rotation_sweep, byzantine_on_grown_committee,
   43:           dead_member_removed, demote_to_observer].
   44: 
   45: %%%===================================================================
   46: %%% suite setup: found N=1 on a default-open genesis; generate all keys
   47: %%%===================================================================
   48: 
   49: init_per_suite(Config) ->
   50:     {FPub, _} = FKey = quod_identity:generate(),
   51:     %% chain the joiner keys so FPub < J1 < J2 < J3 < J4 — sort order = admission order, so the round-robin
   52:     %% leader for any slot at any committee size is computable (via quod_simplex:leader/2).
   53:     JKeys = chain_keys(FPub, 4),
   54:     Identities = maps:from_list(
   55:                    [{Pub, #{pubkey => Pub,
   56:                             key => quod_identity:key_term({Pub, Seed})}}
   57:                     || {Pub, Seed} <- [FKey | JKeys]]),
   58:     FAddr = {"127.0.0.1", ?FOUNDER_PORT},
   59:     GenesisPl = write_genesis(Config),
   60: 
   61:     Founder = start_node(?FOUNDER_PORT, FKey, Config, #{},
   62:                          #{mode => create, committee => [], genesis_file => GenesisPl}),
   63:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> slot(Founder) =:= 1 end, 10000)),   %% genesis committed
   64:     GH = peer:call(Founder, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?NS]),
   65:     ?assert(is_binary(GH)),
   66:     start_brahms(Founder, FAddr, []),
   67: 
   68:     [{founder, Founder}, {fpub, FPub}, {faddr, FAddr}, {gh, GH},
   69:      {genesis_pl, GenesisPl}, {jkeys, JKeys},
   70:      {identities, Identities} | Config].
   71: 
   72: end_per_suite(Config) ->
   73:     quod_ct:stop_all([?config(founder, Config)]),
   74:     ok.
   75: 
   76: %%%===================================================================
   77: %%% cases (ordered; joiner list threads via save_config)
   78: %%%===================================================================
   79: 
   80: %% CASE 1 — the production-rollout step-2 dress rehearsal at N=1: swap the committed DEFAULT-OPEN can_join
   81: %% for the peer_ready gate in ONE atomic transaction (retract the fact + assert the rule), then prove the
   82: %% gate is live (a never-digested ghost is refused). This is a CONTENT change — no peer_admitted op — so it
   83: %% commits via normal OCC, never the membership verdict; and every later admit runs under the upgraded rule.
   84: policy_upgrade_live(Config) ->
   85:     Founder = ?config(founder, Config),
   86:     FPub    = ?config(fpub, Config),
   87:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> match_ok(prove(Founder, {acl_sovereign, {'X'}})) end, 20000)),  %% kb ready
   88:     Rule    = {':-', {can_join, {'N'}, {'A'}, {'P'}}, {peer_ready, {'P'}}},
   89:     Upgrade = {',', {retract, {can_join, {'X'}, {'Y'}, {'Z'}}}, {assertz, Rule}},
   90:     ?assert(eventually(
   91:               fun() -> ordinary_write_ok(prove(Founder, Upgrade)) end,
   92:               20000)),
   93:     %% the gate is now live: a ghost that never digested is refused (can_join :- peer_ready fails).
   94:     {GhostPub, _} = quod_identity:generate(),
   95:     ?assertMatch({fail, [_ | _]},
   96:                  prove(Founder, {admit, GhostPub, "127.0.0.1", 9999})),
   97:     ?assertEqual([FPub], committee(Founder)),   %% no membership change happened
   98:     {save_config, []}.
   99: 
  100: %% CASE 2 — admit of a mid-catch-up node is refused. Pump a multi-window log, start J1 with a slow digest
  101: %% period, and IMMEDIATELY assert the admit fails: a node that is mid-catch-up never digests (follows/4
  102: %% false), and the first post-`done` digest can't fire before J1's ~6s jitter floor — so the refusal holds
  103: %% regardless of how fast catch-up runs (DA#3: assert the refusal, not the transient state).
  104: admit_refused_mid_catchup(Config) ->
  105:     Founder = ?config(founder, Config),
  106:     ok = peer:call(Founder, growth_SUITE, pump, [?NS, ?PUMP], 120000),
  107:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> slot(Founder) >= ?PUMP end, 60000)),
  108:     J1 = {_J1Peer, J1Pub, J1Port} = start_joiner(1, Config, #{feed_anti_entropy_ms => ?SLOW_DIGEST}),
  109:     %% immediately (within the digest-free floor) — the candidate cannot be ready yet, so the admit is
  110:     %% refused regardless of how far catch-up has progressed (the refusal is what we assert, not any
  111:     %% transient join state — that would be a tautology for a mode=join node and can race the 1s status budget).
  112:     ?assertNot(peer_ready_at(Founder, J1Pub)),
  113:     ?assertMatch({fail, [_ | _]},
  114:                  prove(Founder, {admit, J1Pub, "127.0.0.1", J1Port})),
  115:     {save_config, [J1]}.
  116: 
  117: %% CASE 3 — grow 1→2: once J1 has caught up and is digesting fresh, the admit commits; J1 self-promotes to
  118: %% a voter; an UNPACED probe write (the promotion race, healed by Slice-B redrive) commits at quorum(2)=2.
  119: grow_to_two(Config) ->
  120:     Founder = ?config(founder, Config),
  121:     [{J1Peer, J1Pub, J1Port} = J1] = prev_joiners(Config),
  122:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> synced(J1Peer) end, 60000)),
  123:     admit(Config, [J1], J1Pub, J1Port),
  124:     ExpectCommittee = lists:sort([?config(fpub, Config), J1Pub]),
  125:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> committee(Founder) =:= ExpectCommittee end, 20000)),
  126:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> committee(J1Peer) =:= ExpectCommittee end, 20000)),
  127:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> role(J1Peer) =:= validator end, 20000)),
  128:     %% unpaced probe on the founder immediately (the race window); commits only if the joiner votes.
  129:     probe(Config, [J1], {promoted, two}),
  130:     {save_config, [J1]}.
  131: 
  132: %% CASE 4 — grow 2→3: the ZERO-PRE-SEED proof. J2 has met only the founder (seed) — it learned J1's address
  133: %% ONLY by folding J1's peer_admitted fact out of the replayed log (Slice D). At quorum(3)=3 the probe can
  134: %% commit only if J1 and J2 exchange shares, i.e. that fold actually let them dial each other.
  135: grow_to_three(Config) ->
  136:     Prev = prev_joiners(Config),
  137:     J2 = start_joiner(2, Config, #{}),
  138:     {J2Peer, J2Pub, J2Port} = J2,
  139:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> synced(J2Peer) end, 60000)),
  140:     Members = [J2 | Prev],
  141:     admit(Config, Members, J2Pub, J2Port),
  142:     ExpectCommittee = member_pubs(Config, Members),
  143:     [ ?assert(eventually(fun() -> committee(P) =:= ExpectCommittee end, 20000)) || P <- member_peers(Config, Members) ],
  144:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> role(J2Peer) =:= validator end, 20000)),
  145:     probe(Config, Members, {grown, three}),   %% quorum(3)=3 ⇒ needs J1<->J2 dial
  146:     {save_config, Members}.
  147: 
  148: %% CASE 5 — grow 3→4: at four members f=1, the first genuinely fault-tolerant committee (quorum(4)=3).
  149: grow_to_four(Config) ->
  150:     Prev = prev_joiners(Config),
  151:     J3 = start_joiner(3, Config, #{}),
  152:     {J3Peer, J3Pub, J3Port} = J3,
  153:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> synced(J3Peer) end, 60000)),
  154:     Members = [J3 | Prev],
  155:     admit(Config, Members, J3Pub, J3Port),
  156:     ExpectCommittee = member_pubs(Config, Members),
  157:     [ ?assert(eventually(fun() -> committee(P) =:= ExpectCommittee end, 20000)) || P <- member_peers(Config, Members) ],
  158:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> role(J3Peer) =:= validator end, 20000)),
  159:     probe(Config, Members, {grown, four}),
  160:     {save_config, Members}.
  161: 
  162: %% CASE 6 — every validator leads protocol work in a healthy N=4 sweep.
  163: %% Empty carriers can occupy intervening views, but never material heights.
  164: rotation_sweep(Config) ->
  165:     Members = prev_joiners(Config),
  166:     Peers = member_peers(Config, Members),
  167:     Pubs = member_pubs(Config, Members),
  168:     H0 = synced_height(Peers),
  169:     Before = [{P, peer:call(P, quod_simplex, stats, [?NS])} || P <- Peers],
  170:     lists:foreach(fun(I) ->
  171:         View = maps:get(protocol_view, status(hd(Peers))),
  172:         Leader = peer_of(Config, Members, quod_simplex:leader(View, Pubs)),
  173:         ?assert(eventually(fun() -> ordinary_write_ok(
  174:             prove(Leader, {assertz, {rot, I}})) end, 20000)),
  175:         ?assert(eventually(fun() -> synced_height(Peers) =:= H0 + I end, 20000))
  176:     end, lists:seq(1, length(Pubs))),
  177:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Prior}) ->
  178:         Current = peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, stats, [?NS]),
  179:         ?assert(maps:get(proposals, Current) > maps:get(proposals, Prior)),
  180:         ?assertEqual(maps:get(progress_timeouts, Prior), maps:get(progress_timeouts, Current)),
  181:         lists:foreach(fun(I) ->
  182:             ?assert(eventually(fun() -> match_ok(prove(Peer, {rot, I})) end, 10000))
  183:         end, lists:seq(1, length(Pubs)))
  184:     end, Before),
  185:     {save_config, Members}.
  186: 
  187: %% CASE 7 — Byzantine injection on the GROWN committee (grown ≡ co-founded): a crafted membership proposal
  188: %% from the real slot leader's node is refused support by every honest validator, the slot skips, the
  189: %% committee is unchanged, and an honest write still commits.
  190: byzantine_on_grown_committee(Config) ->
  191:     Members = prev_joiners(Config),
  192:     Peers   = member_peers(Config, Members),
  193:     Pubs    = member_pubs(Config, Members),
  194:     H = synced_height(Peers),
  195:     V = maps:get(protocol_view, status(hd(Peers))),
  196:     LeaderPub  = quod_simplex:leader(V, Pubs),
  197:     LeaderPeer = peer_of(Config, Members, LeaderPub),
  198:     Before  = committee(hd(Peers)),
  199:     RejBefore = rejects_total(Peers),
  200:     Victim = ?config(fpub, Config),
  201:     Evil0  = tx([{retract, {{peer_admitted, Victim, "wrong-host", 9999, Victim}, true}}]),
  202:     Identity = maps:get(LeaderPub, ?config(identities, Config)),
  203:     Anchor = peer:call(LeaderPeer, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?NS]),
  204:     Status = peer:call(LeaderPeer, quod_simplex, status, [?NS]),
  205:     {ok, Binding} = quod_simplex:history_binding(
  206:                       {?NS, Anchor}, LeaderPub,
  207:                       maps:get(history_projection, Status)),
  208:     Unsigned = quod_transaction:bind_id(
  209:                  {?NS, Anchor},
  210:                  Evil0#transaction{author = LeaderPub,
  211:                                    author_seq = (1 bsl 60) + V}),
  212:     {ok, Evil} = quod_transaction:sign(Binding, Unsigned, Identity),
  213:     Ts     = erlang:system_time(millisecond) + 1000,
  214:     %% A canonical block must reach the validators. A raw record view is
  215:     %% refused by the encoder before the invalid membership test can run.
  216:     #{era := Era, view := V, parent := ParentRef} =
  217:         quod_ct:peer_protocol_position(LeaderPeer, ?NS),
  218:     {ok, Block} = quod_ledger:new_block({Era, V}, ParentRef, maps:get(material_height, quod_ct:peer_protocol_position(LeaderPeer, ?NS)) + 1, {batch, [Evil]}, Ts),
  219:     Chan   = term_to_binary({log, ?NS}, [deterministic]),
  220:     Frame  = quod_simplex:encode(?NS, {propose, Block, []}),
  221:     _ = [peer:call(LeaderPeer, quod_quic, send, [Fp, Chan, Frame]) || Fp <- Pubs, Fp =/= LeaderPub],
  222:     [ ?assert(eventually(fun() -> maps:get(protocol_view, status(P), -1) > V end, 20000))
  223:       || P <- Peers ],
  224:     ?assertEqual([H], lists:usort([slot(P) || P <- Peers])),
  225:     ?assertEqual(Before, committee(hd(Peers))),
  226:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> rejects_total(Peers) > RejBefore end, 5000)),
  227:     probe(Config, Members, {after_byzantine, V}),
  228:     {save_config, Members}.
  229: 
  230: %% CASE 8 — dead member removed. Slice C REFUSES a dead candidate (the gate's job), so admit a LIVE J4
  231: %% (N=5), then kill it and prove the 4 live still commit at quorum(5)=4, then remove the corpse (the retract
  232: %% verdict is has_clause-only — liveness-agnostic — so a dead member CAN be removed).
  233: dead_member_removed(Config) ->
  234:     Prev = prev_joiners(Config),
  235:     J4 = start_joiner(4, Config, #{}),
  236:     {J4Peer, J4Pub, J4Port} = J4,
  237:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> synced(J4Peer) end, 60000)),
  238:     Five = [J4 | Prev],
  239:     admit(Config, Five, J4Pub, J4Port),
  240:     FivePubs = member_pubs(Config, Five),
  241:     [ ?assert(eventually(fun() -> committee(P) =:= FivePubs end, 20000)) || P <- member_peers(Config, Five) ],
  242:     probe(Config, Five, {five, alive}),   %% proves J4 votes at quorum(5)=4
  243: 
  244:     %% Kill J4. A probe that initially targets J4's slot can commit only after
  245:     %% the four live members complaint-skip it (quorum(5)=4) and retained
  246:     %% custody retargets the signed submission to a live leader. This proves the
  247:     %% four live members still make progress with a corpse in the committee.
  248:     ok = peer:stop(J4Peer),
  249:     Live = Prev,
  250:     LivePeers = member_peers(Config, Live),
  251:     probe(Config, Live, {corpse, in, committee}),
  252: 
  253:     %% remove the corpse: the retract verdict needs only that the exact peer_admitted clause is present
  254:     %% (liveness is never consulted), so a DEAD member is removable. Back to N=4.
  255:     remove(Config, Live, J4Pub),
  256:     FourPubs = member_pubs(Config, Live),
  257:     [ ?assert(eventually(fun() -> committee(P) =:= FourPubs end, 20000)) || P <- LivePeers ],
  258:     probe(Config, Live, {corpse, removed}),
  259:     {save_config, Live}.
  260: 
  261: %% CASE 9 — demote a LIVE member (4→3): J3 commit-signs its own removal, then degrades to a feed-following
  262: %% observer — role=observer, and its height still tracks new commits via the feed with the fact in its KB.
  263: demote_to_observer(Config) ->
  264:     Members = prev_joiners(Config),
  265:     %% demote the highest-pubkey member (a real voter, never the founder) — leadership order is by pubkey,
  266:     %% so this is a well-defined live member.
  267:     {DemotePeer, DemotePub, _} = lists:last(lists:keysort(2, Members)),
  268:     Remaining = [M || M <- Members, element(2, M) =/= DemotePub],
  269:     remove(Config, Members, DemotePub),
  270:     RemainingPubs = member_pubs(Config, Remaining),
  271:     [ ?assert(eventually(fun() -> committee(P) =:= RemainingPubs end, 20000)) || P <- member_peers(Config, Members) ],
  272:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> role(DemotePeer) =:= observer end, 20000)),
  273:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> synced(DemotePeer) end, 20000)),
  274:     %% the demoted node now FOLLOWS the feed: a fresh write on the remaining committee reaches its KB.
  275:     probe(Config, Remaining, {aftr, demote}),
  276:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> match_ok(prove(DemotePeer, {aftr, {'X'}})) end, 20000)),
  277:     {save_config, Remaining}.
  278: 
  279: %%%===================================================================
  280: %%% growth helpers — submit a write/admit/remove through a committee member (zero pre-seed)
  281: %%%===================================================================
  282: 
  283: %% Commit `Goal` through a member. `eventually` may retry an explicit
  284: %% pre-consensus refusal (for example, an admit whose candidate is not yet
  285: %% digesting-fresh), but match_ok stops on an ambiguous outcome or transport
  286: %% timeout so an in-flight write is never resubmitted.
  287: commit(Peers, Goal, Budget) ->
  288:     eventually(fun() -> lists:any(fun(P) -> match_ok(prove(P, Goal)) end, Peers) end, Budget).
  289: 
  290: admit(Config, Members, Pub, Port) ->
  291:     Peers = member_peers(Config, Members),
  292:     ?assert(commit(Peers, {admit, Pub, "127.0.0.1", Port}, 40000)).
  293: 
  294: remove(Config, Members, Pub) ->
  295:     Peers = member_peers(Config, Members),
  296:     ?assert(commit(Peers, {remove, Pub}, 40000)).
  297: 
  298: %% A probe write that must commit and land in EVERY member's KB (all heights converge, fact readable).
  299: %% Read back the GROUND fact directly — an exact match (a variable-filled query would match any same-shape
  300: %% fact, weakening the check).
  301: probe(Config, Members, Fact) ->
  302:     Peers = member_peers(Config, Members),
  303:     ?assert(eventually(
  304:               fun() ->
  305:                       ordinary_write_ok(
  306:                         prove(hd(Peers), {assertz, Fact}))
  307:               end, 40000)),
  308:     [ ?assert(eventually(fun() -> match_ok(prove(P, Fact)) end, 20000)) || P <- Peers ].
  309: 
  310: %%%===================================================================
  311: %%% node harness (one OS node each; own identity + QUIC listener) — NO resolver pre-seeding
  312: %%%===================================================================
  313: 
  314: start_joiner(N, Config, EnvOverrides) ->
  315:     Port = maps:get(N, ?JOINER_PORTS),
  316:     Key  = {Pub, _} = lists:nth(N, ?config(jkeys, Config)),
  317:     Extra = #{mode => join, genesis_hash => ?config(gh, Config), seed_peers => [?config(faddr, Config)]},
  318:     Peer = start_node(Port, Key, Config, EnvOverrides, Extra),
  319:     start_brahms(Peer, {"127.0.0.1", Port}, [?config(faddr, Config)]),
  320:     {Peer, Pub, Port}.
  321: 
  322: %% Start one node in its own OS node: identity env, QUIC listener, fast Δ, then the namespace. Crucially
  323: %% NO quod_quic:learn — every pubkey→addr hint must establish itself (the point of the suite).
  324: start_node(Port, {Pub, Seed}, Config, EnvOverrides, Extra) ->
  325:     Name = list_to_atom("grow_" ++ integer_to_list(Port)),
  326:     {ok, Peer, _Node} = peer:start(
  327:                           #{name => Name, connection => standard_io, args => ["-pa" | code:get_path()]}),
  328:     _ = peer:call(Peer, logger, set_primary_config, [level, warning]),
  329:     _ = peer:call(Peer, application, load, [quod]),
  330:     KeyTerm = quod_identity:key_term({Pub, Seed}),
  331:     Set = fun(K, V) -> ok = peer:call(Peer, application, set_env, [quod, K, V]) end,
  332:     Set(listen_port,   Port),
  333:     Set(node_addr,     {"127.0.0.1", Port}),
  334:     Set(node_pubkey,   Pub),
  335:     Set(identity_key,  KeyTerm),
  336:     Set(identity_cert, quod_identity:mint_cert({Pub, Seed})),
  337:     Set(simplex_delta_ms, ?DELTA_MS),
  338:     maps:foreach(Set, EnvOverrides),
  339:     DataDir = quod_ct:datadir(Config, Port),
  340:     Set(effect_journal_data_dir, DataDir),
  341:     Set(foreign_log, #{cache_dir => filename:join(DataDir, "foreign-history")}),
  342:     try peer:call(Peer, application, ensure_all_started, [quod]) of
  343:         {ok, _} -> ok
  344:     catch Class:Reason:Stack ->
  345:         %% Preserve the original startup failure and deadline. Query stacks
  346:         %% through the peer controller, independently of application startup.
  347:         Diagnostics = catch begin
  348:             Pids = peer:call(Peer, erlang, processes, []),
  349:             [{Pid, peer:call(Peer, erlang, process_info,
  350:                             [Pid, [registered_name, current_stacktrace,
  351:                                    status, message_queue_len]])} || Pid <- Pids]
  352:         end,
  353:         ct:pal("application startup failed; peer stacks: ~p", [Diagnostics]),
  354:         _ = catch peer:stop(Peer),
  355:         erlang:raise(Class, Reason, Stack)
  356:     end,
  357:     Cfg = maps:merge(#{node_id => Pub, identity => #{pubkey => Pub, key => KeyTerm}, data_dir => DataDir},
  358:                      Extra),
  359:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_ns_sup, start_namespace, [?NS, Cfg]),
  360:     Peer.
  361: 
  362: start_brahms(Peer, OwnAddr, Seeds) ->
  363:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_brahms, start_namespace, [?NS, #{node_id => OwnAddr, seed_peers => Seeds}]),
  364:     ok.
  365: 
  366: %% Build the default-open genesis ontology in the suite's priv_dir (the shipped quod_root.pl carries the
  367: %% peer_ready rule; here case 1 upgrades to it live). can_invoke default-open so proves aren't fail-closed.
  368: write_genesis(Config) ->
  369:     Path = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "growth_root.pl"),
  370:     ok = file:write_file(Path,
  371:         <<"acl_sovereign('grow:d').\n"
  372:           "can_invoke(_Goal, _Principal, _Chain, _Ns).\n"
  373:           "can_join(_Ns, _Addr, _Pk).\n">>),
  374:     Path.
  375: 
  376: %% Run ON the founder peer: commit ?N writes locally (no per-write CT round-trip). Retries each write past
  377: %% the post-boot {error,rebuilding} window; at N=1 each prove commits synchronously.
  378: pump(Ns, N) ->
  379:     lists:foreach(fun(I) -> pump1(Ns, I, 200) end, lists:seq(1, N)).
  380: pump1(_Ns, I, 0) -> ct:fail({pump_retries_exhausted, I});
  381: pump1(Ns, I, Tries) ->
  382:     case quod_prolog:prove(Ns, {assertz, {pump, I}}) of
  383:         {ok, _, _} -> ok;
  384:         {error, rebuilding} ->
  385:             timer:sleep(20),
  386:             pump1(Ns, I, Tries - 1);
  387:         Other ->
  388:             ct:fail({pump_failed, I, Other})
  389:     end.
  390: 
  391: %%%===================================================================
  392: %%% query + topology helpers
  393: %%%===================================================================
  394: 
  395: chain_keys(_Lo, 0) -> [];
  396: chain_keys(Lo, N)  -> {P, _} = K = quod_ct:generate_key_gt(Lo), [K | chain_keys(P, N - 1)].
  397: 
  398: prev_joiners(Config) ->
  399:     case ?config(saved_config, Config) of
  400:         {_Prev, Joiners} when is_list(Joiners) -> Joiners;
  401:         _ -> ct:fail("missing saved_config from the previous ordered case (chain broken)")
  402:     end.
  403: 
  404: member_peers(Config, Joiners) -> [?config(founder, Config) | [P || {P, _, _} <- Joiners]].
  405: member_pubs(Config, Joiners)  -> lists:sort([?config(fpub, Config) | [Pub || {_, Pub, _} <- Joiners]]).
  406: peer_of(Config, Joiners, Pub) ->
  407:     case Pub =:= ?config(fpub, Config) of
  408:         true  -> ?config(founder, Config);
  409:         false -> element(1, lists:keyfind(Pub, 2, Joiners))
  410:     end.
  411: 
  412: %% Wait until every peer reports the same height, then return it (the committee is quiescent between writes).
  413: synced_height(Peers) ->
  414:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> length(lists:usort([slot(P) || P <- Peers])) =:= 1 end, 20000)),
  415:     slot(hd(Peers)).
  416: 
  417: peer_ready_at(Judge, Pk) ->
  418:     peer:call(Judge, quod_feed, peer_ready, [?NS, Pk, peer:call(Judge, quod_prolog, applied, [?NS])]).
  419: 
  420: status(Peer)    -> peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, status, [?NS]).
  421: slot(Peer)      -> maps:get(slot, status(Peer), -1).
  422: role(Peer)      -> maps:get(role, status(Peer), undefined).
  423: synced(Peer)    -> maps:get(syncing, status(Peer), true) =:= false.   %% caught up + confirmed the tip
  424: committee(Peer) -> maps:get(committee, status(Peer), []).
  425: prove(Peer, Goal) -> quod_ct:peer_prove(Peer, ?NS, Goal).
  426: 
  427: rejects_total(Peers) ->
  428:     lists:sum([maps:get(membership_rejects, peer:call(P, quod_simplex, stats, [?NS]), 0) || P <- Peers]).
  429: 
  430: %% a raw #transaction carrying an arbitrary diff (the Byzantine-submitter path — no admit/remove predicate)
  431: tx(Diff) ->
  432:     {ok, Goal} = quod_durable_term:encode_goal(byzantine_membership_change),
  433:     {ok, Result} = quod_durable_term:encode_result(#{}),
  434:     #transaction{tx_id = <<>>, origin = {?NS, <<0:256>>},
  435:                  proof_id = <<0:256>>, plan_digest = <<0:256>>,
  436:                  goal = Goal, result = Result, diff = Diff,
  437:                  read_check = #{}, author = <<0:256>>, sig = none}.
